representation_fit.evidence: Screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900) show a physical spatial canvas: three named zones (收集箱/进行中/已完成) with live counts, 9 cards carrying world coordinates (e.g. 100,160) and zone badges, dotted 20px grid, status chips (缩放/选中/卡片/网格). Source matches: ZONES with world rects (app.js:13-17), zone membership by card center point (app.js:99-102), proximity neighbors ≤120px (app.js:103-106), snap to 20px grid (app.js:96). Direct match to brief shape 'spatial-workspace / canvas_object / 落位即意图' (brief.md).

primary_task_salience.evidence: The spatial board is the structural dominant (reg-canvas marked 'dominant workspace surface', index.html:34-44; sidebar summary + status chips visible in both screenshots), but BOTH operator captures show the 键位契约 help modal open over the initial page, hiding 2 of 3 zones and ~6 of 9 cards. Source shows the default state is modal-hidden (index.html:82 'hidden'; app.js:75 helpOpen:false; startup app.js:547-554 never opens it), so the underlying screen is canvas-first, but as captured the overlay competes with the primary task.

time_to_understand.evidence: What/where is conveyed fast: document title '落位板 · Placement Board — 落位即意图' (index.html:6), toolbar motto '空间操作 = 键盘等价 · 落位即意图' (index.html:31), zone tags with counts, per-card zone badge + coordinate, sidebar 工作区摘要 3/3/2/1 matching status 卡片 9 in both screenshots. Deduction: the captured first frame is a help dialog, so the full object field requires dismissing it (Esc/?/关闭, index.html:86). Model-judged proxy only.

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero structural navigation: the primary object (canvas_object) is the first screen; select = 1 click or Tab (app.js:277-283, 413-430), create = N / double-click / toolbar (app.js:285-307, 483-489, index.html:16), single mode with no routes; sync startup with inline seed so board is ready at load (app.js:23-33, 546-554), matching the brief's '加载完成即可用' constraint. Even the overlay in the captures is one Esc away.

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions are in-situ: in-place title edit on the card itself via contentEditable (app.js:365-391), drag/arrows rewrite zone membership live without leaving the board (app.js:333-338, 459), zone moves 1/2/3 auto-slot and confirm via non-blocking toast (app.js:117-125, 340-348), delete is undoable (Ctrl+Z, app.js:325-331). No routing, no blocking dialogs for actions; pointer input while help is open is ignored, not destructive (app.js:414).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces = toolbar (8 buttons, index.html:15-29), canvas, 4 status chips (index.html:49-54), one inspector column with two mutually exclusive blocks (index.html:60-79); help is an on-demand overlay (index.html:82-90). Each control maps to a brief-required spatial op and carries its keyboard equivalent as a kbd badge — no decorative chrome, matching 'quiet chrome, canvas-dominant' (styles.css:1).

accessibility.evidence: Receipt (measurement-summary.json): a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.target_size=pass, a11y.focus_order=skipped. Source corroborates contrast/size risk: .card-coord 9.5px #b0a995 on white (styles.css:128-131), .zone-count 10.5px dim (styles.css:88), 10px kbd (styles.css:29). Tab is globally intercepted for card cycling (app.js:509) so toolbar buttons are not Tab-reachable, cards are tabIndex=-1 role=button (app.js:145-146) with no :focus-visible styles in styles.css, and the zones container is aria-hidden so zone tags/counts are invisible to AT (index.html:38). Target size passing is the only strong positive.

frontend_rework.evidence: 3 of 7 receipt checks failed (measurement-summary.json: layout.responsive_collision=fail, a11y.contrast=fail, type.min_projected_size=fail), while layout.overflow and text.truncation pass and both screenshots render cleanly with consistent data (卡片 9 = 3+3+2+1). The failures imply rework: min-projected-size/contrast consistent with styles.css:129/29; responsive_collision plausibly the non-wrapping single-row toolbar (styles.css:38-41, white-space:nowrap styles.css:51) but not visible at 1280/1440. Latent code defect: onblur closure references undefined identifier 'id' in startEdit (app.js:375) — a ReferenceError on the blur commit path (masked only because canvas pointerdown commits first, app.js:415).

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Brief seed '空间操作有键盘等价物' is exhaustively addressed: KEYCONTRACTS table is the single source of truth and generates the help layer (app.js:36-67, 394-403); implemented handlers for N/Ctrl+D/Tab/Enter/Esc/arrows(+Shift)/1/2/3/F/[/]/Del/Ctrl+Z/+/-/0/? (app.js:492-531); arrow nudge uses the same 20px snap as pointer drag (app.js:335-336 vs 445) with equivalence stated in the contract (app.js:47-48); zone keys auto-place into free slots (app.js:117-125, 340-348); toolbar mirrors every key with a visible kbd badge (index.html:16-28); both screenshots show the contract dialog enumerating these equivalents.

defects_observed: Receipt layout.responsive_collision=fail (check id) — not reproducible in the 1280x860 or 1440x900 captures; candidate cause is the non-wrapping toolbar row (styles.css:38-41,51) but unverifiable from sanitized summary
Receipt type.min_projected_size=fail and a11y.contrast=fail — consistent with 9.5px #b0a995 card coordinates (styles.css:128-131) and 10px kbd badges (styles.css:29)
a11y.focus_order=skipped — no data; source shows Tab is globally hijacked for card selection (app.js:509) and no :focus-visible styling exists
Latent ReferenceError: startEdit's onblur closure references undefined 'id' (app.js:375)

Both initial captures show the 键位契约 modal open although the source default is hidden (index.html:82; app.js:75; startup app.js:547-554), obscuring 2 of 3 zones and ~6 of 9 cards on the captured first frame
Zones container is aria-hidden='true' (index.html:38), hiding zone names/counts from assistive technology

Viewport/conditions at which layout.responsive_collision was measured are not recorded in the sanitized summary
scores.overall_note: This package is a strong, on-brief realization of create × spatial-workspace: a canvas-dominant single page where zone membership is computed from card center points, positions snap to a 20px grid, and proximity/layering are first-class (app.js:96-107), with the acceptance seed — every spatial operation has a keyboard equivalent — implemented as a generated, single-source key contract mirrored by toolbar kbd badges; the board is fully populated and interactive at load in both viewports with internally consistent counts (卡片 9 = 3+3+2+1 in both screenshots). The main deductions are measured, not visual: 3 of 7 receipt checks failed (responsive collision, contrast, minimum projected type size), the first two corroborated by deliberately small, low-contrast coordinate/annotation text in styles.css; keyboard focus traversal was skipped and Tab is globally intercepted, weakening standard a11y traversal; and a latent undefined-variable bug sits on the edit-blur path (app.js:375). Both operator captures also show the help modal open over the initial page even though the source default is closed, so the captured first frame under-represents an otherwise dominant, task-focused canvas. Task completion time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference remain not observable in this blind pilot; the accessibility and defect scores above are model-judged from receipts plus source, not human testing.
